verses.en: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
verses.pt: A balança enganosa é abominação para o Senhor; mas o peso justo é o seu prazer.
verses.en_web: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
verses.en_bbe: Scales of deceit are hated by the Lord, but a true weight is his delight.

verses.en: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.pt: Quando vem a soberba, então vem a desonra; mas com os humildes está a sabedoria.
verses.en_web: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
verses.en_bbe: When pride comes, there comes shame, but wisdom is with the quiet in spirit.

verses.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.pt: A integridade dos retos os guia; porém a perversidade dos desleais os destrói.
verses.en_web: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
verses.en_bbe: The righteousness of the upright will be their guide, but the twisted ways of the false will be their destruction.

verses.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.pt: De nada aproveitam as riquezas no dia da ira; porém a justiça livra da morte.
verses.en_web: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.en_bbe: Wealth is of no profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness keeps a man safe from death.

verses.en: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.pt: A justiça dos perfeitos endireita o seu caminho; mas o ímpio cai pela sua impiedade.
verses.en_web: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.en_bbe: The righteousness of the good man will make his way straight, but the sin of the evil-doer will be the cause of his fall.

verses.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
verses.pt: A justiça dos retos os livra; mas os traiçoeiros são apanhados nas, suas próprias cobiças.
verses.en_web: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
verses.en_bbe: The righteousness of the upright will be their salvation, but the false will themselves be taken in their evil designs.

verses.en: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
verses.pt: Morrendo o ímpio, perece a sua esperança; e a expectativa da iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
verses.en_bbe: At the death of an upright man his hope does not come to an end, but the hope of the evil-doer comes to destruction.

verses.en: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.pt: O justo é libertado da angústia; e o ímpio fica em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
verses.en_bbe: The upright man is taken out of trouble, and in his place comes the sinner.

verses.en: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.pt: O hipócrita com a boca arruína o seu proximo; mas os justos são libertados pelo conhecimento.
verses.en_web: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: With his mouth the evil man sends destruction on his neighbour; but through knowledge the upright are taken out of trouble.

verses.en: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.pt: Quando os justos prosperam, exulta a cidade; e quando perecem os ímpios, há júbilo.
verses.en_web: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.en_bbe: When things go well for the upright man, all the town is glad; at the death of sinners, there are cries of joy.

verses.en: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.pt: Pela bênção dos retos se exalta a cidade; mas pela boca dos ímpios é derrubada.
verses.en_web: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: By the blessing of the upright man the town is made great, but it is overturned by the mouth of the evil-doer.

verses.en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.pt: Quem despreza o seu próximo é falto de senso; mas o homem de entendimento se cala.
verses.en_web: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
verses.en_bbe: He who has a poor opinion of his neighbour has no sense, but a wise man keeps quiet.

verses.en: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
verses.pt: O que anda mexericando revela segredos; mas o fiel de espírito encobre o negócio.
verses.en_web: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
verses.en_bbe: He who goes about talking of others makes secrets public, but the true-hearted man keeps things covered.

verses.en: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.pt: Quando não há sábia direção, o povo cai; mas na multidão de conselheiros há segurança.
verses.en_web: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
verses.en_bbe: When there is no helping suggestion the people will have a fall, but with a number of wise guides they will be safe.

verses.en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
verses.pt: Decerto sofrerá prejuízo aquele que fica por fiador do estranho; mas o que aborrece a fiança estará seguro.
verses.en_web: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
verses.en_bbe: He who makes himself responsible for a strange man will undergo much loss; but the hater of such undertakings will be safe.

verses.en: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
verses.pt: A mulher aprazível obtém honra, e os homens violentos obtêm riquezas.
verses.en_web: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
verses.en_bbe: A woman who is full of grace is honoured, but a woman hating righteousness is a seat of shame: those hating work will undergo loss, but the strong keep their wealth.

verses.en: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.pt: O homem bondoso faz bem à sua, própria alma; mas o cruel faz mal a si mesmo.
verses.en_web: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
verses.en_bbe: The man who has mercy will be rewarded, but the cruel man is the cause of trouble to himself.

verses.en: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
verses.pt: O ímpio recebe um salário ilusório; mas o que semeia justiça recebe galardão seguro.
verses.en_web: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
verses.en_bbe: The sinner gets the payment of deceit; but his reward is certain who puts in the seed of righteousness.

verses.en: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
verses.pt: Quem é fiel na retidão encaminha, para a vida, e aquele que segue o mal encontra a morte.
verses.en_web: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
verses.en_bbe: So righteousness gives life; but he who goes after evil gets death for himself.

verses.en: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
verses.pt: Abominação para o Senhor são os perversos de coração; mas os que são perfeitos em seu caminho são o seu deleite.
verses.en_web: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
verses.en_bbe: The uncontrolled are hated by the Lord, but those whose ways are without error are his delight

verses.en: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.pt: Decerto o homem mau não ficará sem castigo; porém a descendência dos justos será livre.
verses.en_web: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
verses.en_bbe: Certainly the evil-doer will not go free from punishment, but the seed of the upright man will be safe.

verses.en: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
verses.pt: Como jóia de ouro em focinho de porca, assim é a mulher formosa que se aparta da discrição.
verses.en_web: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
verses.en_bbe: Like a ring of gold in the nose of a pig, is a beautiful woman who has no sense.

verses.en: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.pt: O desejo dos justos é somente o bem; porém a expectativa dos ímpios é a ira.
verses.en_web: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.en_bbe: The desire of the upright man is only for good, but wrath is waiting for the evil-doer.

verses.en: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
verses.pt: Um dá liberalmente, e se torna mais rico; outro retém mais do que é justo, e se empobrece.
verses.en_web: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
verses.en_bbe: A man may give freely, and still his wealth will be increased; and another may keep back more than is right, but only comes to be in need.

verses.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.pt: A alma generosa prosperará, e o que regar também será regado.
verses.en_web: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
verses.en_bbe: He who gives blessing will be made fat, but the curser will himself be cursed.

verses.en: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.pt: Ao que retém o trigo o povo o amaldiçoa; mas bênção haverá sobre a cabeça do que o vende.
verses.en_web: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps back grain will be cursed by the people; but a blessing will be on the head of him who lets them have it for a price.

verses.en: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.pt: O que busca diligentemente o bem, busca favor; mas ao que procura o mal, este lhe sobrevirá.
verses.en_web: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
verses.en_bbe: He who, with all his heart, goes after what is good is searching for grace; but he who is looking for trouble will get it.

verses.en: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.pt: Aquele que confia nas suas riquezas, cairá; mas os justos reverdecerão como a folhagem.
verses.en_web: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
verses.en_bbe: He who puts his faith in wealth will come to nothing; but the upright man will be full of growth like the green leaf.

verses.en: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.pt: O que perturba a sua casa herdará o vento; e o insensato será servo do entendido de coração.
verses.en_web: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.en_bbe: The troubler of his house will have the wind for his heritage, and the foolish will be servant to the wise-hearted.

verses.en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
verses.pt: O fruto do justo é árvore de vida; e o que ganha almas sábio é.
verses.en_web: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
verses.en_bbe: The fruit of righteousness is a tree of life, but violent behaviour takes away souls.

verses.en: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.pt: Eis que o justo é castigado na terra; quanto mais o ímpio e o pecador!
verses.en_web: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth; how much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.en_bbe: If the upright man is rewarded on earth, how much more the evil-doer and the sinner!
